sentences.text: Some special bearings give your distance off without plotting.
The bow and beam bearing is the easiest.
Note the time when a light is forty-five degrees off your bow, and again when it’s abeam, ninety degrees off the bow.
The distance you ran between those two times equals your distance off the light when abeam.
This works because the bearings form a right triangle with two equal sides.
It’s a quick way to check your distance off a light or a headland.
